comment: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares (T19.2). php lists the PHP minor version that the suite runs on, the pin of kit: setup-php installs the latest patch of a minor and cannot pin a patch, so the minor is the pin and each CI run records the patch it ran on in its report. pythonBackend is the build backend of the Python wheel, which make install-tools installs by the sha256 of its wheel. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Go, Python with uv, ruff, vulture, alint, golangci-lint, deadcode, govulncheck, cargo-audit and Composer) and mise.lock locks them for every platform of the bootstrap (T24.12).

exceptions.reason: VS Code 1.138, the minimum of engines.vscode, runs the extension and its server on the Node.js 24.18.1 of its Electron 42.10.0, so the floor of the extension is that Node.js
exceptions.retry: when the minimum engines.vscode of the extension ships an Electron with Node.js 26.11.1 or later
